section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. This comparison was run at the Maplewood Cardiac Group.

Table 5. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 353 | 800 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Blood pressure control | 463 | 800 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
